eyebrow: SQL Server HA, Backup & Disaster Recovery · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 10 · Restore Scenarios

code:
-- Backup expects: D:\SQLData\Prod.mdf
--                 E:\SQLLogs\Prod.ldf

-- Target server has no D:\ or E:\ drive
-- Plain RESTORE DATABASE fails immediately
caption: File paths are stored inside the backup itself.

code:
RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = N'..Prod_Full.bak';
-- logical names: 'Prod', 'Prod_log'

RESTORE DATABASE Prod_Staging
FROM DISK = N'..Prod_Full.bak'
WITH MOVE 'Prod' TO N'C:\SQLData\Prod_Staging.mdf',
     MOVE 'Prod_log' TO N'C:\SQLData\Prod_Staging.ldf',
     RECOVERY;
caption: MOVE uses the logical name from FILELISTONLY, not the physical path.
